description: One-DGX Spark Tencent Hy4 Flash in AngelSlim's SPARK-4Bit-Fast GGUF packing (mixture of experts with Engram tables and multi-token prediction; vision-language with the BF16 projector) on llama.cpp with Tencent's Spark patch, as in the AngelSlim Hy4-flash-GGUF Spark guide: commit 2cbca389 plus patch/hy4-flash-spark.patch, built with CUDA 13.0 for sm_121a in this recipe's own image, without the web UI. The Engram tables sit inside the GGUF and are read from the memory-mapped file on demand (lazy mode, token embeddings on the CPU). MTP drafting, 196,608 tokens of context and one request at a time, with the Spark kernel switches from the guide's Linux block. Images go through the BF16 projector. Thinking is chosen per request. The estimated peak is about 107 GB; the creator publishes no measured memory figure.
title: Hy4 Flash SPARK-4Bit-Fast llama.cpp single Spark (AngelSlim)
